comments.author: ltorvmark
comments.body: This pipeline stage is failing on the nightly: the image height assertion blows up whenever the source is portrait, because the aspect ratio is applied to width twice. The nightly job has been red since this landed.

comments.author: jbergstrom
comments.body: Confirmed and fixed — the ratio is now derived once and passed to both dimensions. The nightly is green again: run 8421. Marking this conversation done on my side; shout if you see a recurrence.
